text: Alex 10-6 ART3: Candlewake is the extra faction (built after the other MVP work); Veiled Table mechanics land (fog enhances same-time play); marks on the land = a post-MVP system (stages, lingering scar, at most one small rule each). Revisit a 4th faction after a round or two of polish.

Lacquer Reed: every kind of wind instrument (recorders etc.) as unit variation and leaders, instrument powers that are actually cool, 'chord' combo gameplay. Kilnborn: the Unfired is awesome; keep the Kiln-Mothers concept but redo the art; loves the Great Kiln in…
